title: Rldcoin: Interstellar Peer-to-Peer Payments
authorization_scope: Owner explicitly requests completing Rldcoin supply and issuance from the interstellar peer-to-peer payment goal, disregarding old issuance. The paper and previously authorized matching official website are revised; no runtime or monetary network is activated.

native_currency.name: runlai
native_currency.currency_identity: C_RLD binds one common authenticated genesis and monetary policy.

issuance.initial_strand_home: D_0, named by a future authenticated monetary genesis; no genesis or keys created by this publication
issuance.placement_authority: Current home BFT quorum exercises public discretionary placement governance; no identity-free fair allocation or automatic domain entitlement claimed.
issuance.strand_transfer: Whole state only; typed export, installation-or-permanent-rejection and certified recovery; preserve identity, counter and provenance; no timeout reallocation.
issuance.mint_authority: One valid public work candidate finalized once by the current strand home; no owner reserve withdrawal or administrative mint.

work_profile.purpose: Distribution only, never global branch selection or validator voting
work_profile.password: SHA256 of canonically tagged candidate including currency, strand, counter, home, opening anchor, payout commitment and nonce
work_profile.salt: first 16 SHA256 bytes of separately tagged currency/strand/counter/home/anchor

equations: U + F + B + Q + Z = C
conservation.condition: Accepted BFT/cryptographic/durable-state assumptions for all payment and issuance provenance; accounting over causally consistent cuts, not an instantaneous observable global total.

claims: A concrete monetary policy and transition-level construction for bounded public-work issuance and authenticated whole-strand relocation, composed with the existing payment architecture. Exact integer schedule reconciles to the lifetime cap. No new BFT, cryptographic primitive, independent security qualification or achieved performance is claimed.
limitations: Initial placement governance can concentrate or withhold issuance capacity; accepted quorum failures can violate safety assumptions. Stranded strands can reduce attainable supply. Fixed work has no calendar emission guarantee, ASIC resistance or promised CPU profitability. Long-term fees, cryptographic succession and operational qualification remain separate from the transition-level design.
implementation_boundary: No protocol/node source, live network, asset balance, monetary genesis, signing keys or adoption policy is changed. Prior receipts, failures, source-bound evidence and existing implementation obligations retain their original scope. A future implementation requires an exact separately identified profile and explicit reconciliation; no test value or keys migrate.
